comments.value: I agree for this greatly. I have too many avatars and it's hard to scroll through them all to find a specific one I want and annoying if I have matching ones but I uploaded them at different points of time and they are now separated by a cookie monster I had to have or something like that.

I just want to add that the difficulty of making an in-game interface customizable could be circumvented by letting people edit it from the web by logging into their vrchat.net accounts.

It's considerably easier to let you re-arrange the avatar list in the browser than having to add more buttons and muddy up the menus.

comments.value: It's been almost 3 years since this post was made and I couldn't agree more. author.name: Scout - VRChat Head of Quality Assurance

details:
what it says on the tin. As is, Avatars are presented in upload order. But it would be nice if there was some way to reorganize your avatarlist. So if I have several versions of my avatar, they aren't spread out across my avatar list because one is older. 

Barring that, something similar to the new groups feature, but for avatars. The ability to select some avatars as "favorites"
title: Ability to organize avatar list
